title: Which age group leaves?
hook: A total can conceal which age group changed.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy fish population, 8 juveniles and 6 adults are present. A rule removes 2 adults and no juveniles. How many adults remain?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: In a toy fish population, 8 juveniles and 6 adults are present. A rule removes 2 adults and no juveniles. How many adults remain?

claims.text: In a toy fish population, 8 juveniles and 6 adults are present. A rule removes 2 adults and no juveniles. How many adults remain? The stipulated adult group falls from 6 to 4 after two adults are removed; the juvenile count stays at 8. This does not predict recruitment or the effects of a real fishing rule.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A toy population has 5 adults; a rule removes 1 adult and no juveniles. How many adults remain? 5 − 1 = 4 adults under the stipulated rule.
